name: Snarkle!
summary: Snarkle! is a dice game inspired by Farkle, set in a fantasy tavern populated by animal characters. Players roll six dice, keep scoring combinations, and choose whether to bank their points or risk another roll. Standard mode uses classic scoring, while Flavors mode introduces customizable dice with special scoring effects. Competitive mode lets players roll simultaneously and use random items to attack opponents or defend themselves. The game features shared-table local play, solo matches against bots, and online competitive multiplayer.
